Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>if minion A uses a forced awakening to block but fails it is untapped?

No. Forced Awakening and Wake with Evening Freshness never untap the vampire.
They allow the tapped vampire to block or play reaction cards as if they were
untapped, but they are NOT untapped.

Halcyan 2
